newsitem.title: USA: Western Wireless says subscriber base rises.
newsitem.headline: Western Wireless says subscriber base rises.

text.p: Western Wireless Corp on Wednesday said its wireless communications subscriber base rose to a total 359,7000 at the end of the fourth quarter, up 51,500 from the previous quarter.
For all of 1996, the company said it added over 145,300 customers to boost its subscriber base by 72 percent over 1995.
Cellular customer numbers grew by 33,700 during the fourth quarter for a total of 324,200. Personal Communications Service (PCS) customers rose by 17,800 for a total 35,500, it said.
